name: Plain Tile
description: Small rectangular plain tiles laid double-lap in broken bond (staggered joints), giving a fine, densely textured roof.

name: Interlocking Pantile
description: Interlocking tiles with a wave (pantile) profile, laid in straight vertical lines.

name: Traditional Pantile
description: Traditional S-shaped (hollow) pantiles with a deep, flowing wave, laid in straight vertical lines.

name: Double Roman
description: Interlocking Roman tiles: flat pans separated by rounded rolls, laid in straight vertical lines.

name: Profiled Tile
description: Interlocking tiles with a ribbed profile of raised vertical rolls, giving strong vertical lines.

name: Medium Format Interlocking
description: Medium-size flat interlocking tiles that look like plain tiles or slates, laid in broken bond.

name: Large Format Flat
description: Large flat interlocking tiles with a clean, slate-like or modern flat appearance and thin straight leading edges.
